question: Can a phi-sweep face-PAB-anchored q0 IC generator plus a coarse joint (q0, omega) grid hit >=4/5 Band A on the pilot seeds?
hypothesis: Phi-sweep ICs over a feasible coarse omega-grid land Band A across the pilot seeds.
narrative_md: Pilot CANCELLED at the design gate: the phi-sweep q0-IC primitive is geometrically sound (q0_err 0.287deg at truth-omega on seed 6) but the omega-grab diagnostic measured a fragility tube of |Delta-dir| <= 1deg and Delta-mag in [-10%, +5%] around truth-omega, so no feasible omega-grid puts a cell inside the tube. Phi-sweep retained as a q0-IC sub-component; joint-search omega-grid architecture refuted.
